picks.title: Ep 1423 | ‘The Odyssey’ & the Bible Tell Two Very Different Stories About Coming Home
picks.summary:
Al, Zach, Christian, and John Luke dig into The Odyssey, comparing Christopher Nolan’s interpretation with Homer’s original, from the diminished role of the Greek gods to Penelope’s complicated fight to preserve her family and kingdom. They explore Telemachus’ struggle to grow up without his father and the stark contrast between men who build and protect and those who simply live off what others have built. The guys ultimately contrast Odysseus’ long journey home with Christianity’s radically different picture of God bringing his people home.



In this episode: Judges; 1 Samuel; Job; Daniel 2
picks.reason: Compares The Odyssey with Christian themes of homecoming and faith.

picks.title: Saturated Wednesday: Are you sleeping in the garden? — Pastor Robbie Gallaty
picks.summary:
In Matthew 26, just hours before the cross, Jesus brings three of His closest friends with Him to pray, yet they can’t stay awake with Him. Night 1 of Saturated was a call for us to wake up, get on our knees and seek the Lord.
What if we spent less time telling God what to do and more time listening to what He’s saying? When was the last time you slowed down long enough to hear the voice of the Holy Spirit?
The world needs a Church that is awake in the garden. May we be people who seek His presence, listen for His voice and are obedient to what He asks of us today.
